translations.acerca.titulo: An event made for {$START_TAG_MARK}everyone passionate{$CLOSE_TAG_MARK} and {$START_EMPHASISED_TEXT}curious{$CLOSE_EMPHASISED_TEXT} about folding paper — a place to meet people who share your interests.
translations.acerca.p1: {$START_BOLD_TEXT}Origami Bogotá{$CLOSE_BOLD_TEXT} offers the chance to learn new techniques, and to step into the world of origami if this is your first time.
translations.acerca.p2: During the event there's folding everywhere: not just in the workshops, but also during breaks and over coffee. For 16 years we've been working so that everyone who loves this art has a place at the event.
translations.acerca.cita: “We have spaces for every level of complexity — from beginners to advanced — and a separate space for kids. It's really exciting to see the most experienced folders take on complex models and put them on display.”
